title: Rayhunter v0.2.8
body:
## What's Changed * TP-Link device support now in main codebase! Installing is still left as an exercise for the user however (install scripts for TP Link coming soon) * Official windows binaries for serial (install script coming soon.) * Many improvements to serial to make installing rayhunter much simpler for people on different architectures * Clarity and efficiency Improvements across the code * Delete old recordings in the web ui * Bugfixes galore! ## Full Release Notes * Add missing Cargo.lock changes by @gaykitty in https://github.com/EFForg/rayhunter/pull/204 * Remove unused import due to e79dc4a by @gaykitty in https://github.com/EFForg/rayhunter/pull/205 * Update rayhunter_daemon for TPLINK Compatibility by @tkerby in https://github.com/EFForg/rayhunter/pull/194 * Added FAQ entry on how to use the rootshell to delete data from the device by @cycloarcane in https://github.com/EFForg/rayhunter/pull/209 * Update README w/ signal instructions by @wgreenberg in https://github.com/EFForg/rayhunter/pull/214 * More clippy fixes by @gaykitty in https://github.com/EFForg/rayhunter/pull/206 * Improve installation doc clarity. Cleanup capitalization. Fixed #169 by @blanchardjeremy in https://github.com/EFForg/rayhunter/pull/177 * feat(serial): replace all panics with error handling from anyhow by @oopsbagel in https://github.com/EFForg/rayhunter/pull/232 * Fix malformed QMDL manifest writes by @untitaker in https://github.com/EFForg/rayhunter/pull/225 * [REPO] Add Issue Templates by @zoracon in https://github.com/EFForg/rayhunter/pull/237 * Fix rendering of last_message_time in UI by @untitaker in https://github.com/EFForg/rayhunter/pull/224 * Fix RecordingStore::create by @untitaker in https://github.com/EFForg/rayhunter/pull/242 * Add delete buttons to web ui by @gaykitty in https://github.com/EFForg/rayhunter/pull/240 * Remove unneeded image dependencies by @gaykitty in https://github.com/EFForg/rayhunter/pull/247 * mac installer: if we've already removed quarantine bit, continue by @wgreenberg in https://github.com/EFForg/rayhunter/pull/219 * Bump tokio from 1.44.1 to 1.44.2 by @dependabot in https://github.com/EFForg/rayhunter/pull/257 * comment was looking for a rusty way by @rusmisel in https://github.com/EFForg/rayhunter/pull/216 * ci: installer for ubuntu-24.04-arm (aarch64) by @oopsbagel in https://github.com/EFForg/rayhunter/pull/255 * Add the content length header to the qmdl file response by @gaykitty in https://github.com/EFForg/rayhunter/pull/253 * Remove RecordingCBM by @untitaker in https://github.com/EFForg/rayhunter/pull/246 * Indent rootshell's code to 4 space like everything else by @gaykitty in https://github.com/EFForg/rayhunter/pull/220 * [REPO] Move Templates to Correct Location by @zoracon in https://github.com/EFForg/rayhunter/pull/243 * Add PR template by @wgreenberg in https://github.com/EFForg/rayhunter/pull/215 * [REPO] Fix Issue Template Bugs by @zoracon in https://github.com/EFForg/rayhunter/pull/258 * Document what the red line means by @untitaker in https://github.com/EFForg/rayhunter/pull/262 * [WIP: needs install.bat] ci: add windows installer by @oopsbagel in https://github.com/EFForg/rayhunter/pull/256 * Add dockerfile for easier building on MacOS by @untitaker in https://github.com/EFForg/rayhunter/pull/265 * ci: statically compile serial binary for linux by @oopsbagel in https://github.com/EFForg/rayhunter/pull/264 * Upgrade axum to reduce binary size by @untitaker in https://github.com/EFForg/rayhunter/pull/235 * ci: add windows target for serial by @oopsbagel in https://github.com/EFForg/rayhunter/pull/266 * ci(windows): compile serial for x86_64-pc-windows-gnu by @oopsbagel in https://github.com/EFForg/rayhunter/pull/267 * Add build flags and display support for TP-Link M7350 by @untitaker in https://github.com/EFForg/rayhunter/pull/226 * Fix delete all recordings, and panic on server startup by @untitaker in https://github.com/EFForg/rayhunter/pull/268 * chore: blameless cargo fmt by @oopsbagel in https://github.com/EFForg/rayhunter/pull/223 * README: Do not mention SD card by @untitaker in https://github.com/EFForg/rayhunter/pull/273 * Remove outdated instructions from README by @untitaker in https://github.com/EFForg/rayhunter/pull/279 * update mm invite by @cooperq in https://github.com/EFForg/rayhunter/pull/281 * bump version by @cooperq in https://github.com/EFForg/rayhunter/pull/287 ## New Contributors * @tkerby made their first contribution in https://github.com/EFForg/rayhunter/pull/194 * @cycloarcane made their first contribution in https://github.com/EFForg/rayhunter/pull/209 * @untitaker made their first contribution in https://github.com/EFForg/rayhunter/pull/225 * @rusmisel made their first contribution in https://github.com/EFForg/rayhunter/pull/216 **Full Changelog**: https://github.com/EFForg/rayhunter/compare/v0.2.7...v0.2.8
This discussion was created from the release Rayhunter v0.2.8.
